```ruby
  def initialize

    @step = 1
    @stack = []

  def bump
    @value += @step
    self
  end
```

```ruby
class AttrParser
  def self.parse(line)
    result = {}
    i = 0
    while i < line.length
      if line[i] == '"'
        # This is the opening quote of a value
        j = i + 1
        while j < line.length
          if line[j] == '"'
            value = line[i+1...j]
            i = j + 1

            # Now look backwards for the key
            k = i - 1
            while k >= 0 && line[k] != '='
              k -= 1
            end
            if k >= 0
              key = line[k-1..k-1] # the character before '='
              key = key.to_sym
              result[key] = value
              i = k
            end
            break
          end
          j += 1
        end
      end
      i += 1
    end
    result
  end
end
```
